title: Why Is Everyone Talking About Alphabet Stock? | GOOG Stock Deep Dive Part 2
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc works through Alphabet's mixed quarter to explain why the shares dropped after the report. The positives are clear: Google Cloud revenue grew 103%, the Gemini app has over 1 billion active users, proprietary TPUs are gaining usage, and more efficient models are coming for developers. The negative is decelerating Google Search, but he argues it is deliberate: Alphabet is prioritising the search experience in AI Mode and AI Overviews over monetisation for now, and those products monetise less heavily than traditional search, creating a revenue headwind. He is a Workspace user himself and says he would pay double the current price for it. He also covers Waymo, now over 300 million fully autonomous miles across 15 US cities, with San Antonio, San Diego and Tampa newly opened and expansion planned into Canada, Germany, Singapore and Spain. He argues Waymo is well ahead of Tesla on tangible driverless results despite Tesla's far better marketing, and doubts Tesla can flip a switch to nationwide driverless given local bureaucracy. No explicit call in this video; his 31 October GOOGL BUY stands unchanged, with the verdict apparently sitting in Part 3, still members-only.
